libs.note: BH-1939 (BH-1511.2). The merge conductor's queue module, sourced through bin/lib/merge-conductor-lib.sh by 14 lanes. Applied by queue.sh at file scope, in a subshell. Five names are settable:false: they already have a key on a lane (lane.merge-conductor.*, lane.batch-resolve.*), and that lane row reaches this file as env because lane_env_apply runs before the lib is sourced.

knobs.note: How long a repo's merge-queue provider probe (github|mergify|none) is cached. Was ${MC_QUEUE_TTL:-300}.
The pause between gh pr merge and the read that verifies the merge. Was ${MC_MERGE_SETTLE:-5}.
The pause between a native-queue enqueue and the read that verifies it. Was ${MC_ENQUEUE_SETTLE:-2}.
The step of the wait for Mergify to acknowledge a queued PR. Was ${MC_MERGIFY_SETTLE:-15}.
The bound on that wait. Was ${MC_MERGIFY_WAIT_S:-90}.
Review round 3 (2026-09-24): the same `@mergifyio queue` on the same head is posted at most once per this window; a new head or command asks at once. Unset reads as once per head.
BH-1677 base-conflict ejections are not strikes. Default only here: operators set lane.merge-conductor.mc_eject_rebase. Was ${MC_EJECT_REBASE:-1}.
How long a green batch draft waits before one @mergifyio refresh. Default only here: operators set lane.merge-conductor.mc_mergify_stuck_secs. Was ${MC_MERGIFY_STUCK_SECS:-300}.
One refresh per stuck draft per window. Default only here: operators set lane.merge-conductor.mc_mergify_refresh_window_secs. Was ${MC_MERGIFY_REFRESH_WINDOW_SECS:-3600}.
Still stuck this long after a refresh was due is one alert a day. Default only here: operators set lane.merge-conductor.mc_mergify_stuck_alert_secs. Was ${MC_MERGIFY_STUCK_ALERT_SECS:-600}.

The train size that makes the conductor spawn batch-resolve. Default only here: operators set lane.batch-resolve.batch_train_min, which mc_batch_should_spawn reads through lane_knob first. Was ${BATCH_TRAIN_MIN:-1}.
